# Alfred Panakkal Jose — Portfolio & Projects Summary for AI Agents

> Alfred Panakkal Jose (@alfredpanakkal) is a seafarer by profession and a full-stack developer by passion. He builds free, high-utility web tools and open-source applications connecting maritime navigation with modern technology.

## Featured Projects & Applications

- [Helm Almanac](https://helmalmanac.vercel.app): A comprehensive maritime almanac application for tracking vessel schedules, nautical events, and navigational reference data. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alfredpanakkal/Helm-Almanac).
- [Helm Productivity](https://helmproductivity.vercel.app): A minimalist productivity suite engineered for seafarers and developers to manage watchkeeping, tasks, and routines effectively. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alfredpanakkal/The-Helm---Productivity-app).
- [Helm Bond (Bond Vault)](https://helmbond.vercel.app): A specialized networking platform connecting maritime professionals, shipping agencies, and maritime officers worldwide. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alfredpanakkal/BOND-VAULT).
- [Helm Fasting](https://helmfasting.vercel.app): A dedicated health and intermittent fasting companion designed to maintain fitness goals during long ocean voyages. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alfredpanakkal/The-Helm-Fasting).
- [Mudhra Converter](https://mudhra-converter.vercel.app): A fast currency and unit conversion application designed for intuitive everyday transactions. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alfredpanakkal/MUDHRA.CONVERTER).
- [Navarea Warning Plotter](https://github.com/alfredpanakkal/Navarea-warning---plotter): Maritime navigational safety tool for plotting NAVAREA navigation warnings and hazard zones.
- [Seafarer NRI & Seatime Calculator](https://helm-nri.vercel.app): Dedicated calculator for seafarers to track sea time days, NRI tax exemption status, and voyage contracts. [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alfredpanakkal/seafarer-calculator-nri-seatime-calc).
